annotations.title: Is this quote on that page?

description: Paid, $0.005 USDC on Base via x402 (agent-audit). Fetches the page now and reports whether the quote is really there: found_exact/found_near/partial/not_found/page_unavailable, similarity, context and page sha256. Call without payment to get the x402 requirements.

payment.description: Optional. A signed x402 v2 PaymentPayload for this tool's PaymentRequired (as an object, or base64 as in the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE HTTP header). Prefer params._meta["x402/payment"]. Omit it to get the exact payment requirements first.

name: quote_check
